question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'advanced'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• In the context of the passage, the word "**cosmetically**" suggests **a high level of development or advancement in the beauty and cosmetic industry.** South Korea is renowned for its innovative and advanced cosmetic products
